system.description:
Pilgrimage teaches that faith which never leaves home is faith that has never been tested. The aspect is represented by a weathered traveller carrying a staff beneath an endless road or a doorway opening upon a distant horizon. Its roadside shrines are often maintained by travellers rather than priests.
The journey is more important than simply reaching a destination. Pilgrims are expected to encounter unfamiliar peoples, question assumptions, carry stories between communities and discover that sacred things rarely remain confined within temple walls.

Edicts: Undertake meaningful journeys. Protect travellers and sacred roads. Respect the customs of communities through which you pass. Carry useful knowledge between distant peoples. Offer hospitality to peaceful travellers when able.

Anathema: Prevent harmless travel merely to exercise control. Desecrate a waystone, roadside shrine or recognised place of shelter. Refuse reasonable aid to a traveller in genuine distress. Demand that another culture practise your faith exactly as it is practised at home.

Suggested Ethics: Autonomy, Benevolence, Adaptability

Class Skill: Survival

Specialist Spells: Fluidity (1), Guiding Stone (1), Shifting Step (1), Wellspring of Valour (1), Element Ward (7), Resilient Fortitude (7), Unity (7), Vigilant Eye (7)

Bonus Spells: Long Stride (4); Air Walk (6); Water Walk (6); Find the Path (12)

Favoured Weapon: Club

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 7. Add it from the sheet's Divine Aspect slot: the class skill and favoured weapon apply, the bonus spells arrive at their levels, and Use chooses the specialist spell (PP 1 for a Grimward or Cleric).
